main.description: Return the latest known position of every AIS-tracked vessel inside a WGS84 bounding box, as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Backed by mv_vessel_latest_position. Optionally filter by type_class ('cargo','tanker','passenger','fishing','tug','highspeed','sailing_pleasure','military','pilot','sar','lawenforcement','other','unknown'). ADR-2605011500.

bbox.description: [west,south,east,north] in WGS84 degrees. Longitudes wrap allowed (e.g. west=170, east=-170 covers Pacific antimeridian).

types.description: Optional filter by vessel_type_class (see vessel_type_class SQL UDF).

minSog.description: Optional minimum speed-over-ground in knots. Use 0.5 to exclude moored/anchored vessels.

features.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Feature.properties: { mmsi, name?, type_code?, type_class, flag_iso?, sog_knot?, cog_deg?, heading_deg?, nav_status?, ts_ms }.
